PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES ACT 1988

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES

(MEASURES WITHIN INFECTED LOCAL AREAS) (MOVEMENT CONTROL) (NO. 3)

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(2) of the

Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Prevention and Control

of Infectious Diseases (Measures within Infected Local Areas) (Movement Control)

(No. 3) (Amendment) Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 3 March 2021.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases (Measures within

Infected Local Areas) (Movement Control) (No. 3) Regulations 2021 [P.U. (A) 64/2021]

are amended by substituting for the First Schedule the following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

APPLICATION

[Regulation 2]

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District

(2)

Period

1. State of Johore 19.2.2021 – 4.3.2021

2. State of Penang 19.2.2021 – 4.3.2021

3. State of Selangor 19.2.2021 – 4.3.2021

4. Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur 19.2.2021 – 4.3.2021

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District

(2)

Period

5. District of Nabawan, State of Sabah 3.3.2021 – 16.3.2021".

Made 2 March 2021
